name: Calculus-Based Equality Obfuscation
description: Replaced the zero cross-product condition with a condition about the stationary points of inflection of a cubic function. Differentiating the function reveals this occurs if and only if $f_u = f_v$. Models relying on pattern matching will likely fail to symbolically differentiate the function and deduce the equivalence, preventing them from recognizing the underlying 3-coloring problem.
